# Cal/OSHA Workplace Violence Prevention Plan Training

> 2-hour online training for California employees, supervisors and managers on workplace violence prevention plans (WVPP), aligned with California Labor Code Section 6401.9 (SB 553), Labor Code Section 6401.7 and Title 8 CCR Section 3203 (Injury and Illness Prevention Program). Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Law: California Labor Code §6401.9 (SB 553), §6401.7; Title 8 CCR §3203
- Employer duties since July 1, 2024: written WVPP, initial and annual employee training, Violent Incident Log kept five years; applies to nearly all California employers
- Duration: 2 hours; 3 lessons plus final exam
- Credits: 0.2 CEU
- Price: $39.99 per person online; bulk pricing from 2 seats; SCORM, virtual and in-person options
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; English and Spanish
- Certificate: instant PDF on passing, valid 12 months
- Note: employers must also train workers on their own site-specific written plan
- Prerequisites: none

## The four types of workplace violence
1. No legitimate business at the worksite (e.g., robbery)
2. Customers, clients, patients, students or visitors
3. Current or former co-workers, supervisors or managers
4. Personal relationships (e.g., domestic violence that follows an employee to work)

## Main exemptions
Healthcare facilities under Title 8 §3342; Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation facilities; certain law enforcement agencies; employees teleworking from a location of their choosing; worksites with fewer than 10 employees, no public access and an IIPP in place.

## Lessons
1. Understanding Workplace Violence
2. Prevention, Response, and Emergency Preparedness
3. Workplace Violence Prevention Program
